was in the spotlight on Tuesday as investment firm Rosenblatt Securities initiated coverage on the storage maker with a Buy rating and a $2,400 price target.

“New AI compute platforms are creating an opportunity to reposition NAND Flash (NAND) from a commodity storage medium to a more system-critical component of AI infrastructure. Historically, consumer, PC, and smartphone NAND demand was driven primarily by rising density and falling cost per bit,” analyst Kevin Cassidy wrote in a note to clients. “In AI systems, however, expanding model sizes and data-intensive inference increasingly prioritize density, performance, endurance, and supply certainty over the lowest absolute price. We believe positioning NAND closer to compute engines can increase its value to the overall system. Sandisk’s technology roadmap supports this opportunity. With technology and manufacturing partner, Kioxia, the company has advanced NAND process technology for roughly 25 years. Its BiCS8 and BiCS10 platforms improve areal density and lateral scaling, enabling comparable die capacity with fewer 3D layers than certain competing approaches. We believe this can support a favorable bit-cost curve and sustain a performance-and-cost advantage in AI- oriented enterprise storage.”

title: Sandisk in spotlight as Rosenblatt starts with Buy rating
